defs.def: a superintendent in the police （英国的）警官；（美国的）警长

ex.s: First, a girl I met one day told me she was ____43____ for a “super,” referring to a 52.4-mile double marathon.
ex.t: 首先,我一天遇到的一个女孩告诉我____43____,她是一个“超级”,指的是52.4英里的双马拉松。

ex.s: “Herman is super positive and he's a bright light at our school who makes every child feel loved and heard. ”said Bakley.
ex.t: “赫尔曼特别积极，他是我们学校里的一束光，让每个孩子都感到被爱、被倾听。”巴克利说。

ex.s: But for the rest of the time she is a super dog, and we are all really proud of her."
ex.t: 但其余时间她是一只超级狗，我们都真的为她骄傲。

ex.s: If we are not careful, then, we could face a kind of global chess match against very determined, super intelligent machines whose objectives conflict with our own, with the real world as the chessboard.
ex.t: 如果我们不小心，就可能面临一种全球性的棋局，对手是目标与我们冲突、意志坚定的超级智能机器，而真实世界就是棋盘。

ex.s: Unfortunately, that plan seems unlikely to work: we have yet to invent a firewall that is secure against ordinary humans, let alone super intelligent machines.
ex.t: 可惜，那个计划似乎不太可能奏效：我们至今还没发明出一种能挡住普通人的防火墙，更别说超级智能机器了。

ex.s: There are probably decades in which to plan for the arrival of super intelligent machines.
ex.t: 可能有几十年来规划超级智能机器的到来。

ex.s: Others say we can just “switch them off” as if super intelligent machines are too stupid to think of that possibility.
ex.t: 还有人说我们可以干脆“关掉它们”，仿佛超智能机器蠢到想不到这种可能。

ex.s: Still others think that super intelligent AI will never happen.
ex.t: 还有一些人认为超级智能AI永远不会发生。

ex.s: help super intelligent machines work better
ex.t: 帮助超级智能机器工作得更好。

ex.s: What does the author think of the safety problem of super intelligent machines?
ex.t: 作者如何看待超智能机器的安全问题？

ex.s: Dad can cook a super "full English breakfast "of bacon, eggs, beans, sausages and toast with butter if Mum and I can find a way to get him into the kitchen!
ex.t: 如果妈妈和我想办法把他弄进厨房，爸爸能做一顿超级“全套英式早餐”——培根、鸡蛋、豆子、香肠和黄油吐司！

ex.s: Millenniumbutterfly Thanks to AI, I’ve got my own super-smart personal assistant built into my phone.
ex.t: 千禧蝴蝶 多亏了人工智能，我的手机里内置了一个超级聪明的私人助手。

ex.s: But while super-intelligent AI could be the biggest leap forward in human history, if it goes wrong or falls into the wrong hands, it could also be the most dangerous.
ex.t: 但是,虽然超智能AI可能是人类历史上最大的跃进,如果它出错或落入坏人手中,也可能是最危险的.

ex.s: Were they part of a single super-civilisation, as some think?
ex.t: 他们是否是单一的超级文明的一部分?

ex.s: But for people families were destroyed by the super typhoon hit East China in July 2016, that summer was a time of great sadness.
ex.t: 但对于2016年7月冲击东莞的超级台风所摧毁的民众来说,那年夏天是一个非常悲伤的时期.
